name: robinhood-memecoin-bot
description: Robinhood Chain memecoin trading bot — pump.fun sniper with auto-entry, partial take profit, moonbag, Telegram control

scripts.dev:reset: docker exec robinhood_bot_redis redis-cli DEL events:raw events:parsed events:candidates events:approved events:signals events:positions events:notifications && docker exec robinhood_bot_postgres psql -U bot -d robinhood_bot -c 'TRUNCATE positions, risk_evaluations CASCADE;'
scripts.restart: npm run stop; sleep 2; nohup npm run dev > /tmp/bot-run.log 2>&1 & echo 'bot reiniciado em background — logs: /tmp/bot-run.log'
